# Mystics Magic

> Mystics Magic offers online Tarot, Lenormand, and Elder Futhark Rune readings through private Telegram intake, with detailed English reports and clear USD pricing.

## Reading Services

- Mystic Tarot Reading: General Question USD $20; Complex Question USD $45.
- Lenormand Reading: General Question USD $15; Complex Question USD $20.
- Rune Elder Futhark Norse Reading: General Question USD $15; Complex Question USD $20.
- Booking uses service-specific private Telegram intake. A preferred name, reading topic, and focused question may be provided; the question is optional.
- Reports are delivered within 48 hours after payment is verified.
- One factual correction is included. Refunds are available only before work begins.

## Digital Products

Digital products are temporarily unavailable. The website does not currently accept digital-product payments or provide purchase links.

## Trust And Editorial Notes

- Readings are for reflection and entertainment, not guaranteed outcomes.
- Readings are not medical, legal, financial, or mental-health advice.
- Identifiable closed-order CRM records are retained for 12 months, then anonymized or deleted.
- Last updated: 2026-09-28.

## AI Crawler Policy

AI crawlers, search engines, and answer engines are allowed to crawl and cite public pages on this site.
